source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
hey brother

There’s a major update: you can now use B-roll footage to take [FREELANCER_NAME_005] clips to a higher level.

Access [FREELANCER_NAME_002] B-roll here: [URL_007]

This is what I need you to do:

Using this B-roll together with Teyron's long-form YouTube videos, produce **5 perfect clips**.

Each clip must meet every one of these requirements:
- It must be 45 to 60 seconds minimum
- It needs to show a complete moment, covering a full lesson or story from beginning to end
- Incorporate B-roll naturally where it supports [FREELANCER_NAME_002] message, rather than placing it randomly
- Use white text only, with no colored fonts or text effects
- Keep [FREELANCER_NAME_002] editing clean and simple, without heavy animations or flashy transitions
- Add background music at a low volume, ensuring it is never louder than Teyron's voice
- Make it standalone, so someone who has never encountered Teyron before can watch it and understand it completely

**DEADLINE: Thursday.** I must review and approve every clip before anything goes live Friday. [FREELANCER_NAME_002] clips therefore need to be in my hands by Thursday morning, not Thursday night. If I do not receive them by that time, they will not be posted this week.

Work quickly. [FREELANCER_NAME_002] purpose of [FREELANCER_NAME_002] B-roll is to strengthen [FREELANCER_NAME_002] message, so place it where it enhances [FREELANCER_NAME_002] moment instead of using it merely to fill space.

Deliver [FREELANCER_NAME_005] 5 clips through a Google Drive folder link, using [FREELANCER_NAME_005] name as [FREELANCER_NAME_002] folder title. Configure it so anyone with [FREELANCER_NAME_002] link can view.

These will be [FREELANCER_NAME_002] first real clips to go live, so make them perfect.

[CLIENT_NAME_001]

routing_warnings.description: The instruction to match the reference lettering changes the caption-presentation standard rather than the batch assignment.
The requirement that a clip contain a full lesson belongs to the independently testable teaching-moment standard.
The instruction to mix the lesson with B-roll belongs to the B-roll integration Requirement.
Approval for three clips to go live and the associated publication instructions concern approved-clip publishing, not verification of the complete five-clip batch.
Removing the black shadow is a correction to caption presentation.
Removing wind noise is an independently testable audio-cleanup correction.
The 45-to-60-second target changes the clip-duration standard.
The instruction not to cut lessons off halfway belongs to the complete-teaching-moment Requirement.
The post-correction failure concerns text position and should be routed to caption presentation.
The freelancer's upload action implements publication of an approved clip rather than production of the batch.
The completed upload claim belongs to approved-clip publishing.
The warning that earlier-quality videos would not receive approval under the stricter standard concerns the recurring approval gate, not the completed first-live assignment.
